description: This file implements a WebSocket server that bridges Playwright MCP and Chrome Extension, handling CDP commands and extension communication.

classes.name: CDPRelayServer
classes.description: A server that relays CDP commands between Playwright MCP and Chrome Extension, managing WebSocket connections and command forwarding.

classes.name: ExtensionConnection
classes.description: Manages a WebSocket connection to a Chrome extension, handling message sending, receiving, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: cdpEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket endpoint URL for CDP communication.

methods.name: extensionEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket endpoint URL for extension communication.

methods.name: ensureExtensionConnectionForMCPContext
methods.description: Ensures an extension connection is established for a given MCP context, with timeout and abort handling.

methods.name: _connectBrowser
methods.description: Spawns a browser process with parameters to connect to the extension relay.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and closes all connections.

methods.name: closeConnections
methods.description: Closes all active WebSocket connections with a reason.

methods.name: _onConnection
methods.description: Handles new incoming WebSocket connections, routing based on URL path.

methods.name: _handlePlaywrightConnection
methods.description: Manages a WebSocket connection from Playwright MCP client.

methods.name: _closeExtensionConnection
methods.description: Closes the extension WebSocket connection and resets state.

methods.name: _resetExtensionConnection
methods.description: Resets extension connection state and promise.

methods.name: _handleExtensionConnection
methods.description: Handles a new extension WebSocket connection, setting up message handlers.

methods.name: _handleExtensionMessage
methods.description: Processes messages received from the extension, such as forwarding CDP events.

methods.name: _handlePlaywrightMessage
methods.description: Processes messages from Playwright, handling CDP commands and responses.

methods.name: _handleCDPCommand
methods.description: Handles specific CDP commands, including 'Browser.getVersion' and 'Target.setAutoAttach'.

methods.name: _forwardToExtension
methods.description: Forwards CDP commands to the extension connection.

methods.name: _sendToPlaywright
methods.description: Sends a message to the Playwright MCP WebSocket client.
